comments.author: @veldawells2839
comments.text: O'Connell, Daniels and Dockers rise to the challenge and deliver. Just finished watching this spittoon spitting, gun slinging and bandit chasing series on Netflix. Absolute awesome. Not for then squeamish. Very moving, tragic, gritty and bloody, where morals and devotion are tested. Superb historical setting, great production, amazing cast, direction executed spot on, costumes perfect, and storyline is just gripping. It's all about character development and it all ties up in last two episodes, with the finally being absolutely "bloody" tense. I love the personal reflections or dreams by some of the characters, about their past history, and how their mindset has affected their behaviour towards others. Highly recommend.
